When performing calculations, please follow these guidelines:

message.content:
Let  
\[
I = \int 2*exp(x)*cos(x)\,dx
\]

Using the known antiderivative:
\[
\int exp(x)*cos(x)\,dx = \frac{exp(x)*(sin(x)+cos(x))}{2}+C
\]

Therefore:
\[
I = 2*\left(\frac{exp(x)*(sin(x)+cos(x))}{2}\right)+C
\]
\[
I = exp(x)*(sin(x)+cos(x))+C
\]

<answer>exp(x)*(sin(x) + cos(x)) + C</answer>
